name: P-88-8991
summary: Milsaperidone, sold under the brand name Bysanti, is a medication used for the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It is an atypical antipsychotic. It is a prodrug of iloperidone and acts as a dopamine D2 receptor and serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist, among other actions. Milsaperidone was developed by Vanda Pharmaceuticals.

pharmacology.text: It is a prodrug of iloperidone and acts as a dopamine D2 receptor and serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist, among other actions.

uses.text: Milsaperidone is indicated for the treatment of schizophrenia; and for the acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder.

sideEffects.en: Reported side effects include dizziness on standing, a fast heart rate, drowsiness and weight gain. Like iloperidone it can lengthen the heart's QT interval, which affects heart rhythm.
sideEffects.zh: 已報告的副作用包括站起時頭暈、心跳加快、嗜睡與體重增加。與 iloperidone 一樣，它可能延長心臟的 QT 間期，影響心律。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已报告的副作用包括站起时头晕、心跳加快、嗜睡与体重增加。与 iloperidone 一样，它可能延长心脏的 QT 间期，影响心律。

fact.en: Milsaperidone is a prodrug of iloperidone, which means the body converts it into that older antipsychotic after it is swallowed.
fact.zh: Milsaperidone 是 iloperidone 的前驅藥物，也就是說服用後，人體會把它轉變成那個較早的抗精神病藥。
fact.zhHans: Milsaperidone 是 iloperidone 的前驱药物，也就是说服用后，人体会把它转变成那个较早的抗精神病药。
